summary: Naomi Nakano-Matsumoto, a nonpartisan incumbent on the Fremont Union High School District governing board, holds a general-election endorsement from CAIR Action and an Ally rating from Vote for Peace, organizations that assess candidates on Gaza and human-rights criteria. Her campaign platform centers on student voice, educational equity, and mental-health resources. The endorsements and rating indicate organizational alignment with pro-Palestine positions on Gaza and Israel policy.
